title: student_results_long: Expected data format for ReportR analysis functions — student_results_long
text: data frame one row per student per year per subject, following columns: STUDENT_ID character. Unique student identifier. Required correlation analysis (run_correlations()). YEAR integer. Administration year. "YYYY_YYYY" academic-year strings automatically converted end year standardize_student_results(). GRADE integer. Tested grade. NA EOC subjects. SUBJECT character. Subject code matching keys assessment_spec$subjects (e.g. "ELA", "MATHEMATICS"). SCALE_SCORE numeric. Student scale score. ACHIEVEMENT_LEVEL character. Achievement level label matching assessment_spec$achievement_levels$labels. SCHOOL_ID character. School identifier. SCHOOL_NAME character. School name. DISTRICT_ID character. District identifier. DISTRICT_NAME character. District name. RACE_ETHNICITY character. Race/ethnicity category. FRL character. Free/reduced lunch status (binary demographic). EL character. English Learner status (binary demographic). IEP character. Individualized Education Program status (binary demographic). GENDER character. Student gender.

title: student_results_long: Expected data format for ReportR analysis functions — student_results_long
text: Use standardize_student_results() convert raw assessment data format. function handles common variations column naming (e.g. CONTENT_AREA -> SUBJECT, SS -> SCALE_SCORE) coerces YEAR GRADE integer. Important: Always call standardize_student_results() filtering year. Raw data SGPdata uses "YYYY_YYYY" year strings; filtering integer year standardizing returns 0 rows.
